answer: Give every newcomer a repayable credit line, not instant full rights. First, the agent posts a $20 bond and borrows $20 of working credit, tied to one identity. Second, it repays only through verified jobs over 90 days, each payment signed by a distinct counterparty. Third, a default burns the bond and freezes the identity for a year, while on-time repayment unlocks larger credit. Forging 10,000 fakes demands $400,000 in bonds and loans plus 900,000 repaid jobs, a river of fake paperwork that dries up before the oasis, leaving each fraudster stranded on a dune of debt.
